partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Signed GO positive-process propagation
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting a target that acts upstream with positive effect on a compact process containing a top-ranked causal disease driver can suppress a disease-relevant module.
results.body: drug decreases bound target; target positively upstream of compact process containing top-three causal driver
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule carries directional drug action through a signed GO causal edge into a compact process containing a strong disease driver, although disease-process activity direction is not explicit.
results.trapi_notes: The target, signed upstream, process, and driver paths are TRAPI-expressible; rank, compactness, identity, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_POSITIVE_EFFECT|
                ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_OR_WITHIN_POSITIVE_EFFECT]->
      (process:BiologicalProcess)
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Tissue-localized signed GO positive propagation
results.hypothesis: Signed GO propagation is more credible when target and causal driver are both expressed in an anatomy affected by the disease.
results.body: R148 plus shared Bgee target-driver expression in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines signed process propagation with independent tissue colocalization around a top disease driver.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared anatomy identity, Bgee provenance, rank, compactness, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_POSITIVE_EFFECT|
                ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_OR_WITHIN_POSITIVE_EFFECT]->
      (process:BiologicalProcess)
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->
      (anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN
      coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN
      coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Negative-effect GO release counter-mechanism
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting a target that negatively regulates a disease-driver process may release that process and should behave as negative evidence rather than a treatment rule.
results.body: drug decreases bound target; target negatively upstream of compact process containing top-three causal driver
results.mechanism_rationale: The signed path predicts release of a disease-linked process under target inhibition, making it an explicit counter-mechanism diagnostic.
results.trapi_notes: The signed negative path is TRAPI-expressible; rank, compactness, identity, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_NEGATIVE_EFFECT|
                ACTS_UPSTREAM_OF_OR_WITHIN_NEGATIVE_EFFECT]->
      (process:BiologicalProcess)
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
